title: Quick start
text: Add a project folder, then create a session. Copy project instructions into the external WebUI project once. Paste the session starter into a new chat. The WebUI model registers its task and TODO. RepoPilot runs local tools; no model is connected.

title: Projects and sessions
text:
Each project binds a folder to its sessions, private state and context packages. Use the project selector and Add project. Its adjacent menu offers Rename and Remove project; removal preserves folders, state, sessions and MCP registrations. Finish or stop running work before switching/removing projects. Archive/delete chats in the session drawer or Chat menu.

title: Menus and keyboard shortcuts
text: Chat, Prompts, Execution, TODO and Context files sit beside the composer. Their menus open upward. Settings holds Projects, Copilot & MCP and Maintenance, opening below its cogwheel. Escape closes all menus/drawers and restores opener focus. Clicking outside also closes menus. Search headers stay fixed above their scrolling results. Escape never submits a message or stops a command.
alt: Settings anchored below the cogwheel, with the menu and opening button outlined in red.

title: Send, Paste + Run and copying
text:
Send detects plain or fenced protocol requests and executes them through the same parser as Paste + Run. Ordinary prose is prepared for the WebUI. Malformed requests return correction errors. Run as model reply imports textbox content explicitly. Copy message for WebUI forwards JSON examples without execution. Paste + Run reads the clipboard. Each turn has one Copy button. Background refresh and restoring a chat never copy or execute anything.

title: Editable role prompts
text: Prompts beside the composer offers Copy Planning/Asking/Implementation/Review prompt and Copy project prompt. These copy exact saved guidance without changing permissions or session modes. Edit prompts opens project-owned Markdown; save before copying. Reset requires confirmation and preserves a recovery copy. Upgrades keep authored files. Project instructions are available before creating a chat.

title: Task and TODO
text: The model calls task to register/resume the objective, then todo to initialize its checklist. Progress remains model-reported unless backed by local evidence. TODO → Reset checklist confirms and archives old items, retaining requirements, decisions and validation. Chats sharing the task must initialize TODO again. Execution → Recovery checkpoint saves local progress when the model is unavailable.

title: Commands and patch approvals
text: Execution chooses the approved validation profile and manages the local command grant. Stop cancels a running command. Native diff tabs open automatically for proposed files; approve or decline the whole proposal. Approval runs the already-selected validation profile. Dirty source editors need saving. Validation records actual results; later source changes make evidence historical.

title: Context files and transfers
text: Context files beside the composer opens the automatically maintained upload checklist. UPLOAD means unconfirmed, REPLACE means changed and KEEP means a confirmed transfer remains valid. Open folder, copy instructions and confirm completed transfers here. Package settings chooses external scope and optional full source. Refreshes coalesce, defer while busy and retry automatically; failures show Retry refresh. The project Context files tab also opens individual artifacts. Local generation/copying never updates the external WebUI or confirms uploads.

title: Context estimates and continuation
text: The ring shows recorded estimated tokens against the advisory limit. Hover/focus for percentage and token counts; click to change the limit. Remote model capacity is unknown. At the threshold, RepoPilot prepares a handoff and shows Continue in new chat. Open the external chat and confirm; the replacement opens with its handoff first. It retains the task but has a distinct chat identifier, initial TODO requirement and fresh command grant. Chat → Generate handoff is available earlier. Nothing forces a rollover.

title: Copilot, MCP and troubleshooting
text: Options → Copilot & MCP enables a project-bound MCP registration or previews workspace harness generation. Native Copilot tools handle editing and execution; RepoPilot MCP provides compact repository retrieval and checkpoints. Missing MCP APIs are reported separately from panel support. Use Maintenance → Diagnostics or Reconnect backend after inspecting interrupted work. Recovery never automatically replays edits or commands.
